title: Lead Game Client Developer
text:
Demo Co. Spruce is a scale-up building fitness apps. We are looking for a lead-level Game Client Developer to join our mobile team. Work is two office days a week in Fennick.

Our stack: csharp, dart. You will work closely with design and product, build offline-first features and ship features end to end.

Modern devices for testing. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.
